documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported a 20% standalone revenue growth for Q1 FY27, driven primarily by price realization rather than volume. Management highlighted strong export momentum, particularly in the U.S. OEM market, and expects this growth trend to continue over the next 2-3 years. While the company is currently expanding capacity at its existing facility, it is evaluating potential greenfield expansion options, including international locations. Despite volatility in raw material and freight costs, management remains confident in maintaining its long-term margin guidance.

guidance.claim: Management targets a sustainable margin of 25% plus or minus 1-2%.
guidance.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

guidance.claim: Management expects domestic value growth to be between 8% and 10% for the next few years.
guidance.quote: our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates the current momentum in export revenue and profitability to persist for the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: Management aims to maintain long-term margins within the range of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin. It is very difficult to comment with exact figures.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects U.S. automotive business to increase by 60-70% over the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

demand_outlook.claim: The company is focusing on the automotive sector for growth in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects growth in general export markets including marine and furnishing segments in Europe and the USA.
demand_outlook.quote: Like we said, there will be growth in the marine, there will be growth in the furnishing segment, and there are other markets also in Europe and in the USA, where we see more potential to grow.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has received significant export orders from the US for OEM supply.
demand_outlook.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply which are making a good contribution to our self-revenue and profitability.

capex_expansion.claim: A new production line is expected to be commissioned by February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating a potential greenfield expansion, which could require a capex of INR 250 crores over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores. Yes, it will be additional. But we can tell you after taking the final call.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest approximately INR 300 crores for a new global manufacturing location.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: A new coating line has been ordered for an existing facility with an expected completion by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

capex_expansion.claim: The investment for the new line in the existing facility will be within INR 50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But because we are doing it in an existing facility, it will be within INR 50 Cr.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 margin was impacted by a 4x increase in shipping costs and raw material price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: The first one, because of the Gulf War the problem arises that impacted the price in Q1. And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: The company has not taken a price increase in the export OEM market for the time being.
margins_costs.quote: So we have not taken any increase from my customer in the export market right now, OEM export market at least for the time being.

margins_costs.claim: Freight costs and maintenance expenses decreased during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency and productivity improvements contributed to margin expansion in the last quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So, our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has received new OEM supply orders from the U.S.A.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold a total volume of 31 million meters during the financial year.
The new coating line is expected to add an average monthly capacity of 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that.

orders_capacity.claim: The additional capacity from the new line is expected to increase revenue by INR 120 crores to INR 150 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash outflows for the current year are expected to be approximately INR 50 crores for the domestic capacity expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: You can say that this year it will be approximately this much.

risks_headwinds.claim: Market volatility and geopolitical issues like the West Asia war make it difficult to finalize plant locations.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The war situation impacted the general export market and delayed dispatches to the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: because of the war situation, our general export market was temporarily impacted. Because there was some material that was supposed to go to the Middle East, but we could not dispatch that material, it was on hold.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the new production line in existing premises.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.
So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% and 10% and export growth between 15% and 20%.
management_commitments.quote: our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

management_commitments.claim: The new coating line at the existing location is expected to be completed by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a capital expenditure of INR 300 crores for a global location.
management_commitments.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.
